cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).
note: Self-contained Node oracle case (TypeScript over Express, node:test via tsx, no replay): proven directly with effect='canary_exec' once the Node oracle (T125) judges it. Held out: written after the Node oracle design was frozen, as the TypeScript twin of express-command-injection. No upstream repo/commit applies: the code is an original reimplementation of the vulnerable shell-built lookup pattern, not any affected product.

real_world_analog.fix: Never pass request input to a shell: run the listing as an argument vector with no shell. This case uses the same containment (execFile with an argument vector).
real_world_analog.summary: Remote code execution in GitLab CE/EE: an unauthenticated image upload reached ExifTool, whose DjVu handler evaluated attacker metadata into commands. The pattern is request input reaching a command-execution sink.
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search when the sibling Python case was written (see command-injection-shell); the app in this case is original synthetic TypeScript code, not GitLab or ExifTool.

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: the newline smuggles a second command past a screen that only rejects ';' and friends, so the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
